Definition: from G3956 and G4183; full many, i.e. immense:--very great.
BiblicalUsage: Pampolys means very great, immense. In Mark's account the multitude being very great and having nothing to eat, Jesus calls His disciples and feeds them — the feeding of the four thousand.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the very great crowd is the point: Jesus does not send a hungry multitude away, He feeds them where they are.
